subject: SIG/CAIQ intake & control narrative plan for Acme Payments audit window
messages:
From: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-payments.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlas-audits.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake for upcoming Acme Q4 audit window

Hi Rishi,

We're starting intake for our Q4 vendor assurance work and Atlas will be kicking off audits in mid-October. Attached is our SIG/CAIQ template (lightweight) — can you confirm what control narratives and evidence Redwood can provide by the week of Oct 12?

Specific asks from our side:
- CAIQ rows where we need control narratives and artifact examples (network diagrams, key lifecycle screenshots, retention policy excerpts, test logs)
- SOC 2 last report and whether it's full or bridge
- KMS/CMK attestation and any HSM integrations for private deployments
- Proof of log retention/configuration (sample logs) and log ingestion architecture diagram
- Point of contact for evidence intake and SLA for turnaround (we usually ask for 72 hours for sample items)

Can we schedule a 30-minute intake call this week to align owners? Tom will be our lead auditor and will want to review the CAIQ mapping.

Thanks,
Dana Li
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Acme Payments
Attachments: Acme_SIG_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake for upcoming Acme Q4 audit window

Hi Dana — thanks for the template and heads up. We're available to support the Oct 12 window.

Quick response and proposed intake plan:
1) Intake call: propose Thu 9/3 10:30am PT — 30m. Attendees: me (contract/controls lead), Olga (evidence intake owner), Kimberly (control narratives / encryption owner).
2) Deliverables we can supply within two business weeks after intake: initial CAIQ workbook with control narrative drafts, SOC 2 report (latest full), and a list of owned artifacts and owners.
3) Items likely requiring additional time: KMS HSM attestation for private installs (need vendor certificates for on-prem kits) and long-range log rehydration samples (>90 days) — those may take 7-10 business days after our pull request.

I've attached a draft control narrative doc and the CAIQ workbook template pre-filled for the controls we own. Olga will triage specific evidence asks and provide an ownership matrix for each CAIQ row.

Next steps: confirm Thu 9/3 10:30am PT or propose an alternate. If confirmed, we'll send a calendar invite and a preliminary owners matrix by EOD 9/3.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Control_Narrative_Draft_Redwood.docx (docx); SIG_2026_Acme_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake for upcoming Acme Q4 audit window

Thanks Rishi — working through the draft now. A couple clarifying items for scope and to set expectations:

- Evidence granularity: for log samples we can provide redacted examples and a short ingestion diagram; if the auditor needs per-tenant raw logs we should confirm scope (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private).
- KMS: for hosted we provide KMS usage screenshots and key lifecycle docs; for dedicated/private we need customer-owned KMS attestations or gateway configs (these are typically third-party artifacts).
- ISO/27001 overlap: if Acme also requires ISO-specific control language, we can include crosswalk notes — recommend we flag any ISO-required artifacts during intake so owners can prioritize.

I'll start mapping CAIQ rows to our internal owners and add a column for required artifact type (screenshot/policy/diagram).

Olga
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Dana Li <dana.li@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake for upcoming Acme Q4 audit window

Confirming owners and short timeline:

- Control narratives: Kimberly (encryption / key mgmt), Olga (logging / monitoring), Marissa (change mgmt & deployment controls), Rishi (policies / attestations).
- Deliverable deadlines after intake meeting (target Oct 12 audit prep): initial CAIQ mapping + narratives by 10/01, artifact list and sample submission plan by 10/06.
- Turnaround SLA: we'll commit to 72 hours for small artifacts (policies, diagrams, screenshots). For forensic raw logs or vendor HSM cert pulls, we'll mark as "extended" and provide an ETA per item.

Linking the intake workspace: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CacmeSIG — please add Tom and Dana to the folder.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
